cases.question: ¿Qué cantidades de tipo Consumo y Producido hubo en transformaciones no anuladas durante mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ti.item_type, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad FROM transformation t JOIN transformation_item ti ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND t.date < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY ti.item_type ORDER BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT ti.item_type AS item_type, SUM(ti.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM public.transformation_item AS ti JOIN public.transformation AS t ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND t.date < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50
